questions.question: Pick appropriate sensor/actuator/ from the given choice for each of the following scenario and justify your reasons a) A liquid level measurement system requires use of a non-contact proximity sensor. Nature of the liquid is murky. A suitable sensor would be (i) Photoelectric (ii) Ultrasonic b) A sensor is required to measure the thickness of rolled metal sheets as it emerges from beneath the roller. The motion is continuous hence a quick measurement is crucial. Measurement system has to supply an electrical signal. A suitable sensor would be (i) LVDT (ii) Linear Potentiometer (iii) Capacitive Sensor c) A proximity sensor is required measuring the position of a target in a dirty environment (dust, grease etc.). A suitable sensor would be (i) Eddy Current Sensor (ii) Capacitive Sensor d) A compact, linear actuator is required for a drilling application in an oil rig. Power requirement is high but the main constraints lie in the weight and size of the actuator. If efficiency is not a major concern, a suitable actuator would be (MTE - 350) Page 2 of 3 (i) Electrical Motor (ii) Hydraulic Actuator e) An automation industry requires the use of an actuator for repeatable movement. Movement of the actuator is expected to be very precise and controlled. A suitable actuator would be (i) Electrical Actuator (ii) Pneumatic Actuator
